svg.text: The tree is ticked 3 times a second. A sequence runs its children left to right:
the next one starts only when the one before it succeeds.
Numbers 1 to 18 load one task or test. 19 loads the full run drawn here. In it, a failed task counts as done, so the run
moves on. Bins has a 120 s limit. The run is recorded to a rosbag. Transition moves between tasks are off in the config.
